selected.title: UK sets out proposal to open up access to iPhone contactless payments
selected.summary: The UK's competition watchdog is consulting on proposals to unlock contactless technology on iPhones, making it easier for Apple Pay rivals to flourish by lowering fees and removing technical ​barriers.
selected.why: UK regulator proposes formal competition rules opening Apple contactless payments to rivals.

reason: UK iPhone payments competition rule: clear policy choice with genuine tradeoffs between access, security, fees and Apple's business model.
angle: Opening iPhone NFC to rivals will reduce fees but may fragment security standards and worsen fraud risk.
